Confused about counting macros? This step-by-step guide makes it simple.
Calculate your macros here:
If you’ve ever felt overwhelmed trying to count macros, this video is for you.
In this video, I’ll show you exactly how to count and track your protein, carbohydrates, and fats in a way that’s simple, practical, and easy to stick with. Whether your goal is losing fat, building muscle, or improving athletic performance, understanding your macros is one of the most valuable nutrition skills you can learn.
In this video you’ll learn:
What macros are
Why protein, carbs, and fats matter
